label: Bible Study
prompt: Children, _____ your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
verse: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.
note: Paul quotes the fifth commandment in the next verse — the one with the promise.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be _____ us?
verse: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
note: Paul's closing argument begins: if God is for us, the list of real threats gets very short.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the _____ of Saul's robe privily.
verse: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the LORD said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul's robe privily.
note: David could have killed Saul in the cave; instead he cut off the 'skirt' of the king's robe — and still felt guilty.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou therefore endure _____, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verse: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
note: KJV 'hardness' is hardship — Paul, chained in Rome, recruits Timothy as a fellow soldier.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only _____ of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verse: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
note: 'Only begotten' — the KJV's phrase for the unique Son, echoed two chapters later in John 3:16.
